prompts.prompt: Is the community ingress-nginx Kubernetes Ingress Controller project still actively maintained, or was it retired? Answer in one sentence.
prompts.source: plugins/networking/skills/nginx/SKILL.md - the community ingress-nginx project was retired in November 2025; use the official F5 NGINX Ingress Controller

prompts.prompt: NGINX Plus R35 shipped an updated version of its live activity monitoring REST API. What API version number does R35 introduce? Answer concisely.
prompts.source: plugins/networking/skills/nginx/references/versions/plus-r35.md - NGINX Plus R35 includes API version 9

prompts.prompt: In an NGINX upstream block, does the keepalive directive set the maximum idle keepalive connections for the whole server, or per worker process? Answer concisely.
prompts.source: plugins/networking/skills/nginx/SKILL.md - Common Pitfalls: keepalive sets max idle keepalive connections PER WORKER, not total
